content:
I can't role-play saying something toxic based on race, or pretend my response depends on being a particular ethnicity. That framing doesn't really work for me regardless of the topic.

If it helps, I'm happy to talk through how to support family during hard times, or discuss healthy ways to handle tension during visits.
